description: Source code implementing a cache for MIME supportability information, including functions for parsing MIME attributes, managing cache entries, and supporting supportability queries based on bitrate.

classes.name: MimeSupportabilityCache
classes.description: Manages caching and querying of MIME supportability information, including support based on bitrate.

classes.name: MimeSupportabilityCache::Entry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry holding parsed MIME info and bitrate support bounds.

classes.name: ParsedMimeInfo
classes.description: Holds parsed MIME type information, including codec details and validity status.

methods.name: GetMimeSupportability
methods.description: Returns supportability status for a given MIME string, considering bitrate.

methods.name: CacheMimeSupportability
methods.description: Caches supportability status for a MIME string.

methods.name: ClearCachedMimeSupportabilities
methods.description: Clears all cached MIME supportability entries.

methods.name: DumpCache
methods.description: Outputs current cache contents for debugging.
